connects to mggraph and gets all the guest users that do not have sponsor set

```powershell

# powershell script to generate external azure users with no sponsora
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "User.Read.All","Directory.Read.All","AuditLog.Read.All" -NoWelcome
$guestUsersTemp = Get-MgUser -Filter "userType eq 'Guest'" -All  -Property "DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity" -ExpandProperty "Sponsors"
#region invites (generated by ai)
$invites = Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "activityDisplayName eq 'Invite external user'" -All
$inviteLookup = @{}
foreach ($log in $invites) {
    foreach ($target in $log.TargetResources) {
        if ($target.Type -eq "User") {
            $inviteLookup[$target.Id] = $log.InitiatedBy.User
        }
    }
}
#endregion
$data = @()
foreach ($user in $guestUsersTemp) {
    $obj = [PSCustomObject]@{
            GuestName       = $user.DisplayName
            GuestUPN        = $user.UserPrincipalName
            LastSuccessfulSignInDateTime        = $user.SignInActivity.LastSuccessfulSignInDateTime
            LastNonInteractiveSignInDateTime    = $user.SignInActivity.LastNonInteractiveSignInDateTime
    }
    $sponsors = Get-MgUserSponsor -UserId $user.Id
    if ($sponsors) {
        $obj | Add-Member -Name "SponsorName" -Value ($sponsors.AdditionalProperties.displayName -join ", ") -MemberType NoteProperty
        $obj | Add-Member -Name "SponsorEmail" -Value ($sponsors.AdditionalProperties.mail -join ", ") -MemberType NoteProperty
    }
    $inviter = $inviteLookup[$user.Id]
    $upninviter = "unknown or aged out...."
    if ($inviter) {
        $upninviter = $inviter.UserPrincipalName
    }
    $obj | Add-Member -Name "InvitedByUPN"  -Value $upninviter -MemberType NoteProperty
    $data += $obj
}

$data | Where-object { [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($_.SponsorName) } | Export-Csv -Path ("C:\git\adam\working\" + (Get-Date).ToString("yyyyMMdd") + "_AzureExternalUsersNoSponsor.csv")



```
